note: Compiled from project records, without a filesystem scan. The BENCH v5 catalogue counted 157 entries across 16 groups; this file carries the roughly 55 with enough recorded detail to migrate (inferred). An entry absent here is absent from this compilation only. file and file_sha256 are null until someone places the HTML by hand. STYLUS was called FEELER in the earlier records; the old name is kept as an alias. chats names the working sessions each entry came from by slug; their transcripts sit in the owner's unpublished archive.

tools.name: COLLAR
tools.blurb: Challenge coin bench. Edge preset registry as r(theta,z) LUTs, drag-in art with the full handle set, raster-in-XY exact-in-Z kernel, the 127-key filament template, shapes and cutouts and casino edge.

tools.name: SPRUE
tools.blurb: Batch plate generator for two-colour flush-inlay coins and 351 guitar picks. Python (sprue.py) plus browser bench (sprue.html). Otsu threshold, min black / min white gap sliders, fill the bed.

tools.name: COAMING
tools.blurb: Cyberdeck case maker. Seven archetypes (fold default), assembled and print-bed views, stage face editor, always-editable part dims, constructive prisms with no CSG, COLLAR art engine on rectangular zones.

tools.name: SLATE
tools.blurb: Clapperboard case for a card game. Barrel hinge r5, gooseneck latch, print audit finding the longest unsupported run of each first layer.

tools.name: CASK
tools.blurb: Round LCD case (Pi plus display) with a bayonet cap, 5in and 4in variants.

tools.name: SASH
tools.blurb: Social battery / availability / drink tally slider badge. First print feedback open: glyphs too small, slide plate can escape at full bars.

tools.name: KNURL
tools.blurb: Mechanical tasbih. 33-flute count wheel, separate flat detent strip, 3-slot Geneva star for rounds, flush inlaid numerals through a cartouche window. First print fixed star interference and a snapped Geneva pin.

tools.name: hack.build coin
tools.blurb: The original python coin generator. Superseded by COLLAR but still the source of the Application-tag fix and the NFC pocket variant.

tools.name: SCABBARD
tools.blurb: One-piece USB drive shell shaped like the SATCHEL mark, plus a plug cap.

tools.name: PLINTH / SYNC32
tools.blurb: Retro console case for a Pi Pico build. Analytic SDF of a rounded rect so chamfer, wall, cavity, lip and snap groove are all thresholds.

tools.name: LOCKET
tools.blurb: Folding Pi cyberdeck, print-in-place hinge, 11 revisions A to K. Parametric across screen and keyboard libraries, live configurator, belt holster.

tools.name: NACELLE
tools.blurb: Glow-in-the-dark screen plus scifi console body with a LEGO stud rail for mounting WASHER or DETENT.

tools.name: CRESSET
tools.blurb: HeatSync logo shaped console case. Superseded by PLINTH.

tools.name: BLOCKS
tools.blurb: LEGO style modular printed electronics. Conductive studs, board seats, printed TPU wires, component bricks, MNA DC solver with piecewise LED, 3D drag and drop with stacking.

tools.name: STYLUS
tools.blurb: 22 archetypes of multimaterial printed sensor. Geometric net checker with joined/apart/apartExcept/makesContact, per-archetype SIM models, HOOKUP schematics, assembly declarations.

tools.name: GIB
tools.blurb: Printed linear slider bench. Three sense modes (touch, membrane pot, finger pot), two body modes, physics readouts from editable resistivity.

tools.name: TANG
tools.blurb: Slide instrument. R6 fully multimaterial: membrane slider neck, face as a printed circuit board with two buried layers and vias, printed pots with a cTPU spider rotor, no resistors.

tools.name: BAFFLE
tools.blurb: One-piece printed instrument, ESP32-C3 plus NS4168 amp plus speaker inside. R3 in progress: six hex keys, longer slider, audio jack, generalised USB opening.

tools.name: KEYWAY
tools.blurb: Cricut copper MIDI control surface. 2x2 force pads plus graded slider, 8-layer material stack, 45 gates.

tools.name: VERNIER
tools.blurb: Capacitive control surface, no Velostat. 6 pads plus 3 wedge sliders, 12 nets, craft-store parts list.

tools.name: QUADRANT
tools.blurb: Radial capacitive surface. 6 annular sector pads plus 3 concentric arc sliders, 12 contacts in one row.

tools.name: SPLINE
tools.blurb: 12-blade radial surface, 18 nets. Radial stub escapes through the hub void.

tools.name: TESSERA
tools.blurb: Voronoi tile surface, 18 nets. Column boundaries snapped to straight channels which ARE the routing.

tools.name: FRET
tools.blurb: Wicki-Hayden isomorphic hex keyboard, 21 nets. Zigzag ribbon routing between interlocked columns. The playable one.

tools.name: STAVE
tools.blurb: Chevron scale strip, 8 keys from one slab, sized to a 4 inch copper tape roll.

tools.name: COFFER
tools.blurb: Five interlocking hex tiles that ground-bridge across seams, plus an ESP32-C3 carrier tile. The port standard is on all six edges of every tile.

tools.name: SHIM
tools.blurb: Circuit business card, CR2032 astable, vinyl-cut copper on a Keystone 3002.

tools.name: SPINDLE
tools.blurb: Dual stepper driver breakout for DETENT. Vinyl-cut copper v5 plus an orderable 2-layer PCB R1 with full gerber verification.

tools.name: ARMATURE
tools.blurb: ESP32-S3 motion and power carrier. 3-source power ORing, 2x DRV8833, gate header, WS2812 chains. Not yet routed.

tools.name: TACK
tools.blurb: hack.build blinky pin. 36 mm round 2-layer with the real logo as mask opening and silk art.

tools.name: SHUNT
tools.blurb: Counterfeit Jumperless shitpost PCB. Full fab set with independent reparse, real silk type from woff2.

tools.name: TRUNNION
tools.blurb: ESP32-C3 carrier with 2 servo headers and a transistor-gated laser output. Orderable and copper-tape versions.

tools.name: ghost detector
tools.blurb: Ghostbusters-style wand-shaped handheld PCB. Feature list stated, not built.

tools.name: round Pi carrier
tools.blurb: Carrier for a 4in round LCD with a low-profile Pi, LiPo power, speakers, GPIO breakout.

tools.name: OGEE
tools.blurb: The 4x4 mechanically multiplexed pin display. 17 revisions. R16 lasercut is the shipped design, R16-P the printed hand-cranked variant, R16-M minimal, R16-C cloth.

tools.name: STIPPLE
tools.blurb: OGEE R17, 10x10 miniature. On-edge comb bars, the pin-free floating balance beam joint, 1.5 mm sheet.

tools.name: OGEE app
tools.blurb: Consolidated distribution HTML carrying all three builds with STL and DXF export. Outlines plus a prism/bisect kernel instead of meshes.

tools.name: HEDDLE
tools.blurb: Printed mechanical metamaterial as an addressable display, flat sheet, PETG plus TPU. Draft concept, not approved.

tools.name: SLUG
tools.blurb: Lasercut gashapon capsule vending machine. Coin acceptor, 28BYJ-48 rotor at exactly 4:1, headless multi-trial physics that caught the arching.

tools.name: TUMBLER
tools.blurb: Parametric gallery of 18 lasercut and printable mechanical logic modules plus a bench for laying out logic circuits.

tools.name: DAVIT
tools.blurb: Pair of pipe-mounted robot arms with grippers. R4 is 9g-only, skeletal truss style, two-level sphere collision proxies with calibrated whitelists.

tools.name: PAWL
tools.blurb: 16 DOF 1/6 scale stepper biped. Rapier sim, five checkers, the render-and-look process fix came from here.

tools.name: SPOOL
tools.blurb: 12-joint 3.7g servo humanoid with a universal saddle and yoke module.

tools.name: PINTLE
tools.blurb: 9g servo pancake joint module, printed slew ring that de-cantilevers the servo output.

tools.name: STANCHION
tools.blurb: Tracked mast robot. Aileron-differential stereo camera head, one mount pattern everywhere (PAD and HORN on the same face of every bracket).

tools.name: SPROCKET
tools.blurb: Devastator-style tracked robot on a NULLLAB Maker-ESP32. BLE firmware plus a hack.build control app with CLASP.

tools.name: DETENT
tools.blurb: Two-mirror stepper laser scanner. Firmware plus control app, four-corner homography calibration, trapezoidal planner with junction lookahead, becoming the BEAM monorepo.

tools.name: BEAM
tools.blurb: The DETENT software as a monorepo: beam-core, beam-sources, beam-link, apps/studio. PRD complete.

tools.name: WASHER
tools.blurb: Pan/tilt laser rig. ESP32 firmware, laser-rig.html, round-LCD UI variant, standalone pattern firmware.

tools.name: KERF
tools.blurb: Single-file WebUSB RTL-SDR receiver, plus a spirit box mode and in-browser WebGPU Whisper.

tools.name: HASP
tools.blurb: Single-file WebUSB Ubertooth One app.

tools.name: LOUVER
tools.blurb: ESP32-CAM (AI-Thinker v1.7, OV2640) camera node with CLASP firmware.

tools.name: PLENUM
tools.blurb: Sub-ambient cooled blue diode head. Enclosed Class 1 gantry, chilled glycol cold plate with dry-purged plenum, design tool.

tools.name: QUENCH
tools.blurb: Portable plasma cut planner. Energy-balance cut speed model, kerf and bevel window, battery and air budget.

tools.name: SKETCH
tools.blurb: Lasercut project design tool at sketch.hack.build. Plate and joint as primitives, op log doubling as a TypeScript script, NFP nesting. Plan shipped, not built.

tools.name: BENCH
tools.blurb: The tool catalogue itself. 157 entries across 16 groups as of v5. Becomes the registry.

tools.name: TOGGLE
tools.blurb: Low profile parametric multimaterial thumbstick, prints in place on four heads. TPU stem with a conductive band bridging wall traces when tilted. Solo and BLOCKS variants, 4 and 8 way.

tools.name: HAFT
tools.blurb: Fully printed game controller. Button groups pick flex, clicky or touch; RP2040-Zero on press-fit bumps or wire cups; click spring solved by a beam solver; drive pad; six exports; five-test suite.

tools.name: GUDGEON
tools.blurb: Print-in-place folding pocket cyberdeck for a GC9A01 round screen and RP2040-Zero with a printed circuit deck face, two buried layers, printed vias, touch pads, finger slider, three body shapes, art editor on three zones.
